name: Hakuoki
storyline:
It is the end of the Edo Era, and the 3rd year of the Bunkyu Era...

The protagonist, Chizuru Yukimura, was raised in Edo and is daughter to a Rangaku scholar. Having lost contact with her father in Kyoto, Chizuru decides to visit him. There, Chizuru witnesses a Shinsengumi soldier killing a bloodthirsty monster. By strange happenstance, Chizuru finds herself connected to the Shinsengumi, and the assassins desperate to kill them.

As time progresses, Chizuru will discover their terrible secret....

Tortured by their own thoughts, the men of the Shinsengumi wield their blades in defense of their faith and ideals, in an era torn apart by chaos. Hidden in the riots that defined the passing of the Edo period, a dark battle within the Shinsengumi begins: A battle that will never be recorded in the pages of history...

■Tea ceremony event

In February 1867, Chizuru is asked to attend a tea party on Kondo’s behalf. She accepts to go accompanied by the Shinsengumi warriors. What’s hidden behind that sudden invitation? What awaits her...?
summary:
A mobile port of the PSP edition. It contains a new exclusive scenario called "Tea ceremony event".

There are two app versions: Simple edition and Premium Edition. In the first, the prologue is playable for free and each chapter must be purchased. The new scenario is available upon purchase of all main episodes in the Simple Edition, but is available right from the start in the Premium Edition.
